business_scope.primary_industry_name: Deep Slurry Trenching and Underground Continuous Cut-Off Wall Works

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France–China Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion (1984, as amended by the 2013 Protocol)
France–United States Convention for the Avoidance of Double Taxation (1994)
EU–Japan Economic Partnership Agreement (2019); EU–Canada CETA (provisionally applied since 2017)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF) arts. L. 561-1 et seq., L. 561-2-2, L. 561-2-3, L. 561-45 to L. 561-49, and R. 561-1 et seq. (AML/CFT and UBO register); Code de commerce arts. L. 123-1, L. 123-36 ff. (RNE/INPI); Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016 and Décret n° 2016-2207 du 31 décembre 2016 transposing Directive (EU) 2015/849; Décret n° 2017-1094 du 12 août 2017 (UBO declarations); CJEU judgment of 22 November 2022, joined cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 WM and Sovim SA (public UBO access invalidated under GDPR).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and current corporate status of foreign corporate shareholder (equivalent of Kbis extract)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial or companies registry in jurisdiction of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing / compliance certificate (certificat de bonne vie et mœurs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry or licensed corporate service provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of passport of each UBO (natural person) and legal manager
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public (or competent registry) in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board resolution of the corporate shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the French SARL and designation of representatives
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of directors / shareholders' meeting of the foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (with certified translation if not in French/English)

Bank reference letter evidencing funding capacity for the stated capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank of the foreign investor

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory Level-1 to Level-3 customer due diligence per CMF arts. L. 561-5, L. 561-6 and R. 561-12. Screening against: EU consolidated financial sanctions list (Reg. (EC) 2580/2001 and Reg. (EU) 269/2014 as amended); UN Security Council Consolidated List; OFAC SDN List incl. 50% rule; French asset-freezing measures (CMF arts. L. 562-1 et seq.); TRACFIN typological guidance. PEP identification per CMF art. R. 561-18; any positive hit or PEP/high-risk nationality triggers mandatory EDD (L. 561-10) and the filing of a suspicious transaction report to TRACFIN where required (L. 561-15).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) via the INPI Data Portal (https://data.inpi.fr) and Guichet Unique (https://procedures.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The dénomination sociale must be lawful, distinctive and non-confusable with existing RNE entries and prior trademarks (Code de commerce art. L. 223-1; CPI art. L. 711-2). Non-Latin script names must be transliterated into Latin characters; a French-language version may be required by the Toubon Law (Law No. 94-665 of 4 August 1994) for documents addressed to the public in France.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: France (when implying state sovereignty or prior official use)
Société (when used misleadingly outside the statutory name structure)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: No statutory extension exists; a new application is required after 56 days. On rejection: (1) re-file immediately with a modified name via the Guichet Unique; (2) within two (2) months from the refusal, submit a written recours gracieux to the INPI Registre National des Entreprises, appending the reasoned refusal and evidence of distinctiveness; (3) if the refusal is upheld, apply to the President of the tribunal de commerce in référé within fifteen (15) days for an order directing registration; (4) where refusal results from a third-party trademark conflict, pursue nullity or opposition proceedings before the tribunal judiciaire. Remedy steps do not suspend applicable filing deadlines.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted subject to limitations: a SARL may be registered at the manager's home (Code de commerce art. L. 123-11-1) or via a licensed commercial domiciliation company (Décret n° 2003-770 du 1er août 2003). For deep foundation/diaphragm wall contracting, virtual office acceptability is conditional: it satisfies legal and invoicing presence but does not substitute for an operational project/site base; a pure virtual-only model is tolerated for five (5) years post-incorporation but materially elevates tax, URSSAF and licence-risk exposure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified baseline 22% per calendar year for an active geotechnical SARL (DGFiP/URSSAF construction-sector intensity); 45% where the registered office is purely virtual and no operational site address is declared.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Guichet Unique / INPI electronic incorporation filing
Statutory publication of the incorporation notice in a journal d'annonces légales (JAL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Décret n° 83-1020 du 29 novembre 1983 pricing; market benchmark

Commercial domiciliation (approved virtual registered office) – first-year fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille and legalization of corporate shareholder and UBO documents

Professional business bank account opening (milestone/LC payment rails)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce, Livre II, Titre II – Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 (régime de la Société à Responsabilité Limitée); Articles R.223-1 et seq.; Code civil general contract provisions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce du lieu du siège social, via the Guichet unique des formalités d'entreprises operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier unique de création d'entreprise, comprising certified statuts, declaration of subscription of shares, evidence of capital deposit, legal-publication certificate, registered-office consent, and declaration of non-conviction of the proposed gérant.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital obligation under Article L.223-2. The share capital is freely fixed by the articles, must be fully subscribed, and cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked bank account or with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations, released solely upon registration of the company.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The subscriber shareholders, acting at the constitutive meeting of the Société à Responsabilité Limitée, resolve: (1) adopt the Articles of Association; (2) confirm the subscription of all shares of the company’s initial capital, fully paid on issue; (3) approve the deposit of cash contributions with the Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations or a bank escrow account, release only upon registration; (4) set the registered office at the address indicated in Article 4 of the statutes, with the lessor’s consent; (5) appoint [Name] as Gérant to represent the company, complete filings before the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and the Guichet Unique; and (6) authorize the Chairperson to arrange legal publication and issue copies.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Clearance and Drafting of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique INPI / RCS name-search database; independent legal counsel for drafting.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify the proposed company name against existing registrations and trademarks on the INPI and RCS databases. Draft the statuts in compliance with Articles L.223-1 through L.223-43, including share capital, corporate purpose, management provisions, and any in-kind contribution report prepared by a commissaire aux apports where applicable.
required_dossiers: Valuation report for contributions in kind if in-kind capital is used
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or queried, present an amended name clearance request via the Guichet Unique or apply for an RCS name-change; the corrected dossier is resubmitted without fresh fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Initial Share Capital in a Blocked Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations or any licensed bank in France.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company under formation. Deposit the fully subscribed cash capital and obtain the depositary certificate ('attestation du dépositaire de fonds') stating that the funds are blocked and will be released only after legal registration.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any mismatch in beneficiary or ownership details by written bank amendment and request a re-issued depositary certificate; if the account is rejected, open a new escrow account and re-execute the deposit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Announcement in an Authorized Journal of Legal Announcements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'annonces légales (JAL) duly authorized for the registered-office département.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft a legal announcement containing the corporate name, legal form, capital amount, registered office, corporate purpose, and identity of the gérant. Publish the announcement in an approved JAL for the département of the registered office before filing the incorporation dossier.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the announcement is invalid or published in a non-approved outlet, cause a corrected announcement to be published in the proper JAL and file the corrected certificate with the registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Single Incorporation Dossier to the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet unique de l'INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitted electronically to the competent Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete and submit the unified S1/SARL incorporation form, upload all required documents, verify all mandatory fields, pay the registry fee online, and retain the acknowledgment of receipt and the file number assigned by the Guichet Unique.
required_dossiers: Declaration of non-conviction and identity of the gérant
Gérant’s criminal-record extract or sworn declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a query or rejection within 15 working days, submit the requested supplementary documents through the Guichet Unique’s follow-up interface; the process may be resumed before the deadline without re-incurring the full fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with the RCS and Issuance of the KBIS Extract
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After substantively correct submission, the Greffe registers the SARL, records the SIREN/SIRET identification numbers, and issues the official KBIS extract evidencing legal existence. The same registration triggers automatic publication in BODACC.
required_dossiers: Approved integration of the full dossier
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the KBIS is delayed or disputed, file a formal request for acceleration with the Greffe and, if necessary, seek a judicial order from the directing judge of the commercial court to compel registration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company registered office, social security authorities, tax office, and selected commercial bank.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first shareholders’ meeting after delivery of the KBIS, record the corporate bank account opening, approve the gérant’s remuneration, execute statutory share-register formalities, and complete tax, social-security, and professional-insurance declarations.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first shareholders’ meeting
DAS2 / tax registration confirmation and RIB
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Rectify any defect in the minutes or register by means of a corrective shareholder resolution; late tax or social-security filings are regularized through the official online rectification procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL) for environmental authorization; OPQIBI / QUALIBAT for professional qualification of deep-foundation and diaphragm-wall contracting.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Professional-qualification certificate OPQIBI 1202 – 'Parois moulées et ouvrages souterrains de génie civil'; where applicable, a prefectoral environmental operating certificate under the Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement (ICPE) regime.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autorité Environnementale – Mission Régionale de l'Autorité Environnementale (MRAe) of the DREAL competent for the site.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Works are typically subject to case-by-case environmental review under Article R.122-2 of the Code de l'environnement; if the diaphragm-wall project involves land take exceeding the threshold, a full EIA report is mandatory. Dewatering discharges and slurry-water reinjection require at least a 'dossier de déclaration loi sur l'eau' under Article R.214-32, with registration or authorization if classifications apply.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Treated slurry discharge: total suspended solids <= 30 mg/L, pH 6.5 – 9.0, petroleum hydrocarbons < 5 mg/L, COD <= 120 mg/L, BOD5 <= 30 mg/L. Fixed combustion engines on site shall comply with ICPE general emission limit values, including CO <= 250 mg/Nm3 and NOx <= 500 mg/Nm3 at reference oxygen content. Bentonite-rich excavation spoil shall be waste-characterized under EWC codes 01 05 04 (non-hazardous) or 01 05 07 (hazardous) before recycling or off-site disposal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety clearance from the Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours for site accommodation, electrical cabling and fuel stores; structural-load certification by a qualified engineer for trench-boxing, slurry tanks, crane foundations and earth-retention systems; occupational-clearance certificate issued to the company's health-and-safety coordinator covering compliance with the Code du travail, the Plan Particulier de Sécurité et de Protection de la Santé (PPSPS), and the collective-prevention tasks specific to deep excavations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministry of Economy and Finance — Portals: impots.gouv.fr (professional corporate tax and VAT filing) and formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique for company/VAT registration); intra-EU VAT validation via VIES at ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SARL obtains its INSEE identifiers (9-digit SIREN and 14-digit SIRET) automatically at incorporation through the Guichet Unique; the competent Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) then assigns the intra-community VAT number in the format FR + 2 check digits + SIREN upon filing the activity-commencement declaration (état 110) and issues the tax management reference (numéro de gestion) used for all DGFiP returns. A foreign EU contractor carrying out deep-foundation works in France registers directly for French VAT with the SIE covering its place of operation or activity; a non-EU contractor must appoint an accredited fiscal representative under article 289 A of the CGI and is issued a dedicated French VAT number even in the absence of a permanent establishment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Default: SARL profits are taxed at entity level under Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS) at 25%, with the first €42,423 of annual profit eligible for the 15% reduced rate where turnover does not exceed €10,000,000. Available elections: (i) small active SARLs may elect pass-through income taxation under article 239 bis AA CGI for a maximum 5-year period; (ii) family SARLs ("SARL de famille") may elect quasi-partnership transparency under the same provision; (iii) groups may elect fiscal integration under article 223 A CGI, consolidating IS at the level of the 95% parent; (iv) hybrid-mismatch outcomes on intra-group financing are neutralised automatically under article 212 bis CGI and are not elective; (v) for VAT, the simplified real regime (réel simplifié) with annual filing is the default for eligible contractors, with an option to return to the monthly normal regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée – TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Franchise en base de TVA (article 293 B CGI) exemption thresholds for 2025: €91,900 for supply of goods and works and €36,800 for supply of services; exceeding either threshold triggers mandatory French VAT registration and full VAT invoicing from the first euro. B2B deep-foundation and diaphragm-wall contracts performed at French sites will in practice force opt-in registration because principals require deductible 20% VAT invoices; works on immovable property located outside France remain outside French VAT scope irrespective of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory e-invoicing under the Facturation Électronique reform (Loi de Finances pour 2024 timeline): from 1 September 2026 all VAT-established businesses must receive structured electronic invoices (Factur-X/EN 16931) through certified Partner Dematerialisation Platforms (PDP) or the public portal (PPF); from 1 September 2027 all must issue e-invoices, with e-reporting of transaction and payment data to DGFiP on the same two-phase schedule. France imposes no real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping for domestic B2B VAT; instead it uses deferred transmission via certified PDP APIs. B2G invoicing to French public entities through Chorus Pro has been mandatory since 2020, and intra-EU sales listings are required monthly.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate applies to goods physically exported from the EU under article 262-I-1° of the CGI where the DGFiP-identified exporter dispatches the goods outside the EU within 90 days of shipment and retains full proof of exit. For cross-border geotechnical works, services relating to immovable property located outside France (whether in the EU or a third country) fall outside French VAT scope under article 259-1° of the CGI; works executed on French soil for a foreign principal remain taxable at 20%, while intra-EU subcontracting between EU-established persons is reverse-charged to the recipient (autoliquidation) pursuant to Directive 2006/112/EC.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: DAU/Single Administrative Document lodged via the DELTA customs system, including valid export declaration number and, where applicable, authorised exporter status
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing physical exit of goods from French/EU territory
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank SWIFT credit confirmation evidencing collection of export proceeds in convertible currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: On audit, DGFiP re-verifies the entire export evidence chain (physical exit, exporter identity, payment trace); any deficiency recharacterises the transaction as a domestic taxable supply, triggering recovery of 20% VAT with late-payment interest at 0.2% per month (article 1727 CGI) and penalties escalating from flat fines to 40% for bad faith (mauvaise foi) and 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres (article 1729 CGI). Artificial relocation of construction services abroad may additionally be challenged as abuse of law under article L.64 of the LPF with the 80% penalty; criminal tax-evasion prosecution under article 1741 CGI carries up to 5 years' imprisonment, a €500,000 fine and confiscation of the commercial advantage obtained.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Direction Générale du Trésor (French Treasury, Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial and Digital Sovereignty), acting jointly with Banque de France (BdF) and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) for prudential supervision, payments oversight, and balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a euro-area State and applies unrestricted current and capital account convertibility under Articles 63 to 65 TFEU. The euro is unconditionally convertible. Profit remittances and dividends of the FR SARL are not subject to French exchange-control or Treasury prior licence; the only practical preconditions are (i) distributable reserves certified by the statutory auditor when required, (ii) settled corporate income tax and withholding-tax declarations, and (iii) compatible EU anti-tax-avoidance substance rules. Foreign-currency accounts (e.g., USD, GBP, DZD) may be opened and retained in France; balances are freely transferable, subject solely to Banque de France statistical reporting, EU/UN and French Treasury sanctions screening, and the SARL's documented source-of-funds file.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender of export proceeds into euro applies in France; no percentage of foreign-currency export receipts is required to be converted or repatriated. The SARL may invoice exports of geotechnical services and construction works in EUR or in any freely convertible currency. Export receipts may be credited to a designated foreign-currency account and retained offshore if commercially justified. For settlements with non-residents above the Banque de France balance-of-payments statistical threshold (for non-financial corporates, practically aggregate cross-border flows above EUR 15 million per calendar year for sampled entities), the SARL must file BOP declarations directly with the Banque de France using the official motive/purpose codes; below that threshold, the clearing bank automatically includes the flows in its own regulatory reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.role_notes: Full-service corporate banking for construction engineering; UCP600 commercial LC issuing and confirming, project escrow, SWIFT corporate access, FX forwards and institutional ISDA clearing. Recommended anchor bank for the SARL.

Strong sector coverage for geotechnical and civil-engineering mid-caps; MT700 LC capabilities, performance guarantees, EUR/USD forwards, and African/Gulf correspondent network suited to deep foundation contracts.

Effective local branch KYC and SME credit; acceptable for operational disbursements and retention guarantees (caution de retenue); documentary LC support is more limited and requires head-office credit approval.
Reliable mid-cap corporate accounts, documentary collection, and standby LC; relevant when the SARL manages multiple public-works retention facilities. Onboarding may take six to eight weeks.
Derivatives-heavy relationship useful for cross-currency swaps, NDFs, and ISDA margining; not a front-office retail treasury provider and cannot be the sole banking relationship.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary digital operations; Low-Medium as the only rail for cross-border treasury. ACPR-licensed Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) such as Qonto, Nium, or Ebury can carry the SARL's euro treasury, execute instant SEPA transfers and direct debits, and provide simple EUR/USD or EUR/GBP conversion. Legal constraints: an EMI is not a credit institution under CRR/CRD IV; it cannot grant trade credit or working-capital facilities, cannot issue UCP600 letters of credit or performance bonds, and cannot legally hold construction-retention money under French public procurement rules. The blueprint therefore uses the Tier-1 bank as the settlement bank and the EMI only for ancillary vendor payments, with all treasury positions netted through the bank account.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: De jure, France permits remote account opening under eIDAS (qualified electronic signature) and the Code monétaire et financier AML regime (articles L.561-1 et seq.); the regulator does not require every director to travel. De facto, all Tier-1 French banks impose on non-EEA directors and UBOs a physical compliance interview at branch or through a French notary/embassy delegate, plus an apostilled notarized power of attorney when the signer cannot appear. A completely remote opening is possible but typically limited to EEA/EU-issued identity documents and an eIDAS Level High digital identity. Budget four to ten weeks for onboarding of a SARL with non-resident directors; document production, UBO register, and source-of-funds evidence are the long-pole items.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-EEA UBOs holding more than 25% of the SARL through an intermediary entity located in a listed tax-non-cooperative jurisdiction or offshore financial centre.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kbis extract issued within the previous three months; notarized and apostilled identity documents of all UBOs; French UBO declaration receipt under article L.561-46 CMF; share register and organizational chart; audited financial statements and tax residency certificate of the intermediate entity to evidence economic substance; independent bank reference letters and transactional history explaining the source of funds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Incoming capital injection from a shareholder or holding company whose payment profile resembles round-tripping or unregistered financial lending.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticated shareholders' resolution approving the capital increase or blocked-account arrangement; certified articles of association; legal opinion confirming the absence of disguised loan or thin-capitalization issue; SWIFT UETR and Banque de France purpose code; confirmation of source of funds (divestiture, salary, audited retained earnings); board treasury minutes justifying the funding need for ISIC 4390 contract mobilization.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Milestone invoices payable by documentary credit from a foreign State-owned contractor located in a jurisdiction with sanctions or high-corruption indices.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed construction contract with ICC Incoterms, payment schedule and dispute jurisdiction; tender award evidence avoiding direct-interest conflicts; insurance and parent-company guarantees; certificate of quantities and work progress (métré/attachement) countersigned by the engineer; negative media and sanctions screening (World-Check/LexisNexis) on the payer and all intermediaries; Sapin II anti-corruption assessment of local agents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Treasury anomalies incompatible with the ISIC 4390 / NAICS 238910 cash cycle: excessive advance mobilization payments, split deposits, or rapid transfers to third-country subcontractors before equipment and labor are visibly deployed.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed mobilization calendar; invoices for diaphragm wall equipment (trench cutters, slurry treatment plants, tremie pipes, polymer/bentonite); site permits and environmental filings (loi sur l'eau / ICPE); project cash-flow budget; subcontracts and supplier contracts; visual/video progression records; external engineering certificates verifying physical quantities.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The compliant route is a SWIFT MT103 (or ISO 20022 pacs.008) credit to the FR SARL's euro IBAN, carrying the Banque de France balance-of-payments purpose code for equity investment / increase of capital (direct investment category) and retaining the UETR for traceability. The bank files the flows in the balance-of-payments; the SARL has a direct statutory declaration duty only if annual cross-border flows exceed the Banque de France threshold for non-financial corporates (practically EUR 15 million in combined receipts/payments) or if selected in a BdF survey. For non-EEA investors acquiring 25% or more of the SARL's voting rights, the parties must screen the transaction against article L.151-3 of the Code monétaire et financier (strategic sectors); geotechnical and diaphragm wall services are not per se a protected sector, but confirmation is warranted when the end-client operates in defense, energy, transport, or critical infrastructure. The documentation envelope for the bank: Kbis, articles of association, UBO register, shareholders' resolution, source-of-funds evidence, certified accounts, and a short legal memorandum showing absence of prohibited financial assistance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 / ISO 20022 pacs.008 for ordinary milestone payments to EU and non-EU subcontractors, using the UETR and the correct BOP service code (construction and engineering services under BPM6); (2) UCP600 commercial and standby credits issued by the relationship bank via SWIFT MT700 when the SARL receives its client's LC or back-to-back imports slurry equipment; (3) performance bonds and retention guarantees (caution personnelle et solidaire / caution de retenue) lodged through the issuing bank's SWIFT network. All outflows must be reconciled with underlying contract liabilities, EU customs declarations, French VAT reverse-charge where applicable, and internal treasury sign-off limits. USD payables for bentonite and heavy machinery should be settled through the same bank with a covering FX forward to lock the treasury margin.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain vanilla FX forwards (change à terme) with tenors aligned to the contract milestone schedule (six to thirty-six months), documented against confirmed export receivables or import payables.
European-style FX options and zero-premium collars with ACPR-regulated French/EEA credit institutions, used to manage USD/EUR, GBP/EUR, and DZD volatility on the construction portfolio.

Cross-currency swaps (CCS) under a 2002 ISDA Master Agreement with EMIR trade reporting and uncleared margin rules (variation margin and initial margin) where the SARL's aggregate derivative notional exceeds the applicable EMIR risk-mitigation threshold.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs), permissible only for emerging-market currencies with restricted convertibility (e.g., Algerian dinar, Egyptian pound), strictly backed by an underlying export contract receivable; NDFs cannot be used for speculation or uncovered positions under the SARL's board-approved treasury policy.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (bilan, compte de résultat, annexe) together with management report and, if mandatory, statutory auditor's report, filed for public record
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) via the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve accounts within 6 months of fiscal year-end; filing with RCS must be completed within 1 month thereafter (absolute maximum 7 months after fiscal year-end)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine up to EUR 7,500 for a legal entity (EUR 1,500 for individuals) plus potential court-ordered injunction with coercive fine; persistent failure may cause RCS deletion of the company's registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs) - update filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not a purely annual filing; mandatory within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership or in the accuracy of the registered particulars; also required at any material control-event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to EUR 7,500 for individuals and EUR 37,500 for legal entities, plus possible imprisonment of up to 6 months for deliberate omission or false declaration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (liasse fiscale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year fiscal periods, online filing by 3 May of the following year; for off-calendar-year entities, within 3 months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 10% of assessed tax, late-payment interest at 0.20% per month, and increased 40% surcharge for intentional or repeated deficiency; ex officio assessment possible after formal notice

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (Commissaire aux Comptes) is mandatory for a SARL if the company exceeds at least two of three thresholds: EUR 4.4 million balance sheet total, EUR 8.8 million net turnover, or an average of 50 employees during the fiscal year. Additionally, shareholders holding at least one-tenth of the capital may petition the court for audit appointment.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général - PCG) is mandatory for individual statutory accounts of a SARL; IFRS is permitted only for consolidated financial statements of applicable groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: French law does not impose a standalone annual UBO confirmation filing. The UBO declaration is filed at incorporation and updated within 30 days of any change. As a best-practice compliance protocol, the SARL must maintain a complete UBO register at the registered office and review it annually at the date of the ordinary shareholders' meeting to detect any unreported changes.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of shareholders (registre des titres de capital)
Register of minutes to include general assemblies and written resolutions (registre des procès-verbaux)
Register of UBO declarations (registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
